script: There is a bug on the checkout page. When I select PayPal as the payment method and click Continue, the page shows a 500 error. I tested it in Chrome on Windows 11. The expected behavior is that I should be redirected to PayPal to complete the payment.
facts: The bug is on the checkout page
Steps: select PayPal as the payment method, click Continue
Actual: the page shows an HTTP 500 error
Expected: the user is redirected to PayPal to complete the payment
